{{Quote|I think we can forgive you this time, Hoole. Give Rikki a scratch behind the ears and I'm sure he'll forgive you, too.|Codru-Ji governor|<ref name="EGTAS" />}}
'''Rikki''' was the [[wyrwulf]] child of the [[Codru-Ji]] [[Unidentified Codru-Ji governor|governor]]. During a meeting that the governor had with [[Mammon Hoole]], Rikki pounced on the [[Senior Anthropologist]] when he arrived at their home and knocked him down. Hoole, having had little time to research the Codru-Ji, reacted instinctively and called Rikki a "mangy beast." Rikki immediately jumped off Hoole and began whining while the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] told Hoole that his son was not a mangy beast. Hoole immediately apologized, using a customary Codru-Ji  gesture. The governor accepted Hoole's apology, advising Hoole to give Rikki a scratch behind the ears so that his son was forgive him as well. Hoole did as the governor advised, and Rikki licked Hoole's fingers in response.<ref name="EGTAS" />
